items.title: Faster Launches
items.subtitle: The tweak's share of startup is down from 237 ms to 134 ms, and leaving the app no longer pauses to save translations.

items.title: Lighter on Memory
items.subtitle: The image caches share a 314 MB budget instead of a possible 690 MB, and all of them empty when iOS warns the app it is low. Browsing wallpapers holds 66 MB less.

items.title: Instant Comment Edits
items.subtitle: Saving an edit no longer waits on a second request, so a step that could take up to 20 seconds finishes in under 40 milliseconds.

items.title: Community Highlights
items.subtitle: Highlights you have already opened are dimmed, and ones with new replies since your last visit are marked.

items.title: Profile Layout Preview
items.subtitle: See what a profile layout looks like before you commit to it.
